entries.en: **Plugin System Released**: Extend Claude Code with custom commands, agents, hooks, and MCP servers from marketplaces
entries.zh: **插件系统发布**：使用来自市场的自定义命令、代理、挂钩和 MCP 服务器扩展 Claude Code

entries.en: `/plugin install`, `/plugin enable/disable`, `/plugin marketplace` commands for plugin management
entries.zh: 用于插件管理的 `/plugin install`、`/plugin enable/disable`、`/plugin marketplace` 命令

entries.en: Repository-level plugin configuration via `extraKnownMarketplaces` for team collaboration
entries.zh: 通过 `extraKnownMarketplaces` 支持仓库级插件配置，便于团队协作

entries.en: `/plugin validate` command for validating plugin structure and configuration
entries.zh: 用于校验插件结构和配置的 `/plugin validate` 命令

entries.en: Comprehensive error messages and diagnostics via `/doctor` command
entries.zh: 通过`/doctor`命令提供全面的错误消息和诊断
避免在`/resume`摘要中提及钩子

entries.en: Changes to the "verbose" setting in `/config` now persist across sessions
entries.zh: 对`/config`中“详细”设置的更改现在在会话中持续存在
